collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLK 2002 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLK Coupe 2002 to 2009 (C209) model which requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Slider wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
